title: Ice Cold
description: Marise Aravel, a food merchant in Riften, uses ground ice wraith teeth as a preservative. She asks the player to bring her five ice wraith teeth to replenish her supply.

base_facts: I sell food at the Riften market and pride myself on its freshness.
I learned a preservation trick from a butcher in Elinhir: grinding ice wraith teeth keeps food fresh.
I need five ice wraith teeth to replenish my supply.

ACCEPT_QUEST: Someone has agreed to find ice wraith teeth for me.
RETURN_WITH_TEETH: My preservative supply has been replenished. I rewarded my helper with a spell tome and pheasant breasts.
Player returns to Marise with 5 ice wraith teeth to complete the quest.

You can also find them in the following locations: Ancient's Ascent , recommended location, actually in Bonechill Passage Forsaken Cave , the previous part of the first zone Throat of the World , the path to High.
These should help keep my stock fresh for quite a while." She will reward you with an apprentice-level Alteration spell tome and five pheasant breasts .

beats.comment: Player learns about Marise's food preservation method using ice wraith teeth.
Player accepts the quest to find 5 ice wraith teeth for Marise.
Player returns to Marise with 5 ice wraith teeth to complete the quest.
